page.content:
Picard's assimilated voice in the Collective.

How Locutus of Borg connects

  • Character: Jean-Luc Picard — Locutus is the Borg name forced on Picard.
  • Faction: Borg Collective — Locutus speaks as a voice of the Collective.

What is Locutus of Borg?

Locutus of Borg is the identity the Collective forces on Picard, the wound First Contact and later stories keep reopening.

Key threads lead to Jean-Luc Picard and Borg Collective.
